name: Scenario P: Free AI Readiness Audit Handler
comments: Triggered by webhook (hook 3040) when a prospect submits the free-audit form on cwiai.net. Extracts 8 form fields, calculates a readiness score (base 50, +10 if monthly_leads >= 50, +15 if after_hours_handling = 'We miss them', +10 if pain_point = 'Missing leads after hours', +10 if industry = Plumbing or HVAC, -10 if monthly_leads < 20, capped at 95). Calls OpenRouter Claude Sonnet 4-6 for a personalized audit report. Sends a branded white-label HTML email to the lead via Resend. Creates a HubSpot contact and deal. Sends an internal alert email to Brian. Error handler sends a Resend alert on failure. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Webhook trigger — receives POST from cwi-site/free-audit.html (hook ID 3040). Extracts all 8 form fields.

variables.name: readiness_score
variables.value: {{min(95; 50 + if(toNumber(1.monthly_leads) >= 50; 10; 0) + if(1.after_hours_handling = 'We miss them'; 15; 0) + if(1.pain_point = 'Missing leads after hours'; 10; 0) + if(or(1.industry = 'Plumbing'; 1.industry = 'HVAC'); 10; 0) + if(toNumber(1.monthly_leads) < 20; -10; 0))}}

metadata.notes: SetVariable — calculates readiness_score: base 50, +10 if monthly_leads >= 50, +15 if after_hours_handling = 'We miss them', +10 if pain_point = 'Missing leads after hours', +10 if industry = Plumbing or HVAC, -10 if monthly_leads < 20. Capped at 95 via min(). Also splits name into firstname/lastname.

notes.content: Module 1: Webhook trigger — gateway:CustomWebHook hook 3040 — receives POST from cwi-site/free-audit.html. 8 fields: business_name, name, email, phone, industry, monthly_leads, after_hours_handling, pain_point.

Module 2: SetVariable — readiness_score: base 50, +10 if monthly_leads >= 50, +15 if after_hours = 'We miss them', +10 if pain_point = 'Missing leads after hours', +10 if industry = Plumbing or HVAC, -10 if monthly_leads < 20. Capped at 95. Also splits name -> firstname/lastname.

Module 3: OpenRouter HTTP POST — anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 — 3-paragraph personalized audit report: score meaning, #1 automation opportunity, specific recommendation. Under 200 words. White-label (no vendor names).

Module 4: Resend HTTP POST — branded white-label HTML email to lead. From env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS / env.RESEND_FROM_NAME. Score in orange. Claude report body. CTA -> env.CALENDLY_LINK. No CWI AI mention.
Module 5: HubSpot HTTP POST — create contact: email, firstname, lastname, phone, company, industry, hs_lead_status=NEW.
Module 6: HubSpot HTTP POST — create deal: '[business_name] — Free Audit Lead', pipeline env.HUBSPOT_PIPELINE_ID, stage env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_NEW_LEAD, associated to contact from module 5.
Module 7: Resend HTTP POST — internal alert from env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS to env.ADMIN_EMAIL. All 8 form fields + score + HubSpot contact link.
Module 8: Error Handler — Resend alert to admin on any failure. Includes error message, module, timestamp (ET), business_name, lead email for manual follow-up.

environment_variables.RESEND_API_KEY: Resend API key for sending emails
environment_variables.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS: Verified sender address for client-facing emails (e.g. hello@yourdomain.com)
environment_variables.RESEND_FROM_NAME: Display name for client-facing emails (e.g. Your Company Name)
environment_variables.OPENROUTER_API_KEY: OpenRouter API key for Claude access
environment_variables.OPENROUTER_REFERRER: HTTP-Referer header value for OpenRouter requests (e.g. https://cwiai.net)
environment_variables.CALENDLY_LINK: Full URL for booking a demo/strategy call
environment_variables.HUBSPOT_STAGE_NEW_LEAD: HubSpot deal stage ID for the New Lead stage
environment_variables.HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID: HubSpot portal/account ID for building contact deep-link URLs
environment_variables.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS: Verified sender address for internal alert emails (e.g. alerts@cwiai.net)
environment_variables.ADMIN_EMAIL: Brian's email address for internal alerts and error notifications
